description: Text-level Vietnamese-English coding utterances. 'reference' is what was said, spelled canonically. 'recognizers' holds recognizer output: 'simulated-live-baseline' is hand-written to reproduce error classes observed with conversational live transcription (spacing splits, lost casing, phonetic substitutions, spoken punctuation, a destructive command misheard as a harmless one). It is simulated text, not measured audio; audio-level runs append measured outputs under their recognizer id.
